title: Bud Powell in Paris
summary: A brief sighting of Bud Powell in a Paris club.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah. But you know, we look at Bud Powell, too, you know, and other folks.
Yeah, yeah. Did you see Bud Powell when he was in Europe?
Once… yeah, I didn’t see him play, but I went once… What’s that club in Paris? The Blue Note, too, right?
Mm-hmm. Yeah, the Blue Note, mm-hmm.
And it was Benjamin. Some person called Benjamin who was running the club. And I went for a drink some… maybe after a concert. And Bud was sitting there. I said, “Hi.” Not… that’s all.
